style: Panic-spiral downward cascade. Purple/black brand system reused verbatim from shared-lead-problem and speed-wins-the-job (same CSS custom properties, League Gothic + Montserrat, persistent radial bg-fill that never clears). Escalating warning-color creep down four staggered lines visualizes a literal downward spiral of bad decisions, landing on a bright payoff line.
reuse_note: Searched catalog for 'descending list stagger cascade text reveal', 'escalating warning sequence spiral downward text', and 'kinetic type headline punch in caption' (npx hyperframes catalog --json). Closest matches (text-stagger, stagger-cascade, kinetic-center-build, caption-kinetic-slam) are generic word/tile staggers with no notion of escalating brand-warning color or a descending vertical cascade tied to this exact purple/black system. Hand-authored per builder.md gap rule, following the proven bespoke pattern already used in the sibling projects shared-lead-problem and speed-wins-the-job (same file structure, same persistent bg-fill, same crossfade-not-hard-cut scene technique).

scenes.emotion: flat, ominous calm — the trigger moment, no urgency yet
scenes.motion: slide_bottom + fade_in, muted color, holds then lifts/fades as PANIC line punches in

scenes.emotion: sudden urgency — brighter, warmer than the hook, first crack in composure
scenes.motion: scale_punch (back.out) in the same centered spot the hook vacates, small shake + glow landing beat, then fades/lifts as the spiral scene crossfades in beneath it (overlap 2.5-2.9s so the frame is never empty)

scenes.text: Money into ads with no system / Prices get discounted / Bad-fit jobs get taken anyway / Panic creates more chaos
scenes.emotion: escalating loss of control — each line sits lower on screen and further down the color ramp from muted-purple toward warning-red than the last
scenes.motion: 4-line descending stagger: each line slide_bottom + fade_in + slight scale_down (1.05->1), staggered starts 2.6/4.1/5.6/7.1s, connected by a small down-arrow glyph that fades/drops in ahead of each new line; color ramps var(--muted) -> var(--accent) -> warm-mix -> var(--negative) across the four lines; the whole stack persists (never clears) through to the end of the piece so it can dim-not-vanish under the payoff line

scenes.text: PANIC IS NOT A MARKETING STRATEGY.
scenes.emotion: the payoff / release — bright, confident, contrasts against the muted-to-warning cascade above it
scenes.motion: fade_in + scale_grow (0.92->1) with a glow pulse on landing, bright accent color (var(--accent-bright)); the spiral stack dims (opacity ~1 -> ~0.32, never to 0) rather than exiting, so nothing is ever fully blank; freeze-hold to end (11.5s) for a clean cut back to host footage
